Nora: Quick flag — bringing up `qwen-bridge` (Gemma->Qwen) on int4. Short prompts look ok, but at ~140 tokens we start seeing repeated \u003cunk\u003e and weird token 0 spikes. Anyone seen encoder remap causing rotary phase jumps?

Diego: Which conversion script? new `vocabsync` or old `merge_vocab.sh`? Any pruning?

Nora: Used vocabsync v2 + --quant=int4 --rotary-scale=1.02. Prune default true. Repro snippet: 
```
[INF] step=138 token=278 logp=-3.1
[INF] step=139 token=0 logp=-13.4
[WARN] sudden eos/pad collision detected
```

Priya: token=0 after step X usually means pad/EOS/invalid remap. Check invisible tokens (NBSP, ZWSP) at head. Did the converter preserve reserved indices?

Nora: Source head: ["<pad>","<unk>","\u00A0","the","to","a","is","\u200D"]. After convert, \u00A0 was gone and indices shifted so \u200D ended up at 1 in some cases.

Diego: That explains behavior. Our kv-cache and some legacy rotary precompute assume pad=0 and reserved slots stable. If zwj lands at 1 or 0, cached key lookups warp and rotary phase misaligns mid-sequence.

Erin: Also double-check runtime rotor: we had an optimization that used token_id modulo head_size for a fallback table; remap breaks that assumption.

Nora: Re-ran conversion with --preserve-reserved and disabled prune. Perplexity numbers: baseline=11.8, converted-pruned=20.3, converted-preserve=12.0. Issue gone.

Priya: Action items: 1) Add a converter lint to reject remaps that place control/invisible whitespace tokens into pad/unk/eos slots. 2) Add a sliding-window logp continuity eval up to 512 tokens (3 seeds) and fail if jump >0.4. 3) Note rotary precompute caveat in onboarding doc.

Diego: Agreed. Also add a runtime check that asserts reserved ids map to expected slots or that a remap table is provided at load time.

ci-bot: build 905 passed for vocabsync on branch onboard/qwen-bridge-preserve :white_check_mark:

Nora: Opening PR with converter flag, lint, continuity test, and docs. Will ping Priya for review.

Priya: Thanks — include the small repro command in PR (longctx_repro script) so QE can run quickly.

Nora: Will do :thumbsup:
notes: vocab remap caused pad/ZWJ collisions -> kv-cache/rotary misalignment; fixed by preserve-reserved and added lints/tests
